deals.evidence: O acordo prevê investimento de R$ 400 milhões em até cinco anos, dos quais R$ 50 milhões são investidos de imediato.
deals.headline: Ronaldo takes 90% of Cruzeiro SAF
deals.summary: Ronaldo signed the contract making official his purchase of the Cruzeiro SAF; the deal provided for R$400m of investment over up to five years, R$50m immediately.

deals.evidence: O negócio gira em torno de R$ 600 milhões.
deals.headline: Ronaldo sells 90% of Cruzeiro SAF to Pedro Lourenço
deals.summary: Supermercados BH owner Pedro Lourenço made official the purchase of Ronaldo's 90% of the SAF for around R$600m (ge reported the value as confidential, and the transaction ran between Tara Sports and BPW Sports Participações, whose partners are Lourenço's children). The association keeps 10%.

notes: cruzeiro.com.br is a JavaScript app whose pages and documents (including the SAF's 2025 financial statements) could not be read, so revenue is the Convocados 2026 report figure for 2025 as reported by MKT Esportivo (Convocados figures are its own standardisation: it gives Flamengo R$1.973bn against the club's reported R$2.089bn). Wages, operating and pre-tax results, net debt, social followers, attendance and honours count were not found on a readable page. Mineirão capacity is stated as 'cerca de 62 mil' (about 62,000). Shirt sponsor not recorded: Minas Gerais decreed in August 2026 a ban on betting advertising in state property such as the Mineirão, and the current master sponsor could not be confirmed. Founding year comes from a 2021 MKT Esportivo kit article (the club's own history page could not be read).

ownership_summary: Football is run by Cruzeiro Esporte Clube - SAF. Ronaldo Nazário (Tara Sports) agreed in December 2021 to take 90% for a R$400m investment commitment; on 29 April 2024 businessman Pedro Lourenço ('Pedrinho', owner of Supermercados BH) bought that 90% through BPW Sports Participações Ltda. for around R$600m; the association keeps 10%. Lourenço is still described as the SAF's owner in September 2026.
revenue_evidence: Na sequência, Cruzeiro somou R$ 716 milhões
